# God Identifies His Son Story Path

**Lesson:** K4-L14 - God Identifies His Son

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for God Identifies His Son.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Matthew 3:13-17

## Big idea

At Jesus' baptism, God publicly identified Him as His beloved Son.

## Guardrails

Teach Jesus' baptism as a narrative event without pressuring children toward their own baptism. | Do not collapse Jesus' unique baptism into a complete pattern for Christian conversion.
